t2.title: Junk food advertising be banned
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should junk food advertising be banned?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Junk food advertising is everywhere, influencing our eating habits. I strongly believe such advertising should be banned or heavily restricted.

Firstly, fast food advertisements contribute to the obesity epidemic. These ads make unhealthy foods appear attractive and desirable, especially to children who cannot distinguish advertising from information. Countries with advertising restrictions have seen improvements in public health.

Secondly, junk food companies spend billions on advertising while healthy food producers cannot compete. This creates an uneven playing field where processed foods dominate our food environment.

However, opponents argue this limits freedom of choice and harms businesses. Nevertheless, we already restrict advertising for cigarettes and alcohol for public health reasons. Junk food causes similar health problems.

Furthermore, banning advertising doesn't ban the products – people can still choose to buy them. It simply removes manipulative marketing that exploits psychological weaknesses.

In conclusion, junk food advertising bans would protect public health, especially children's health, without removing personal choice.
t2.sampleA1:
Junk food? Bad.
Ads? Bad.
No ads!
I no like junk food.
t2.sampleA2:
I think junk food is not good.
The ads are on TV and they are bad for kids.
Kids like the ads and they want to eat junk food.
It is not healthy.
Maybe no more ads because it is bad for health.
t2.sampleB1:
I think advertising for junk food should be stopped.
It's not good for people, especially children, because they see the ads and they want to eat unhealthy things.
For example, there are many ads for sweets and crisps.
These foods are not good for your health.
Also, these companies spend a lot of money on advertising, so it's difficult for healthy food to compete.
However, some people say it's their choice what they eat.
In my opinion, it's important to protect people from unhealthy advertising.
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — this is something I feel really strongly about! In my opinion, junk food advertising should definitely be banned, or at least heavily restricted. The main problem is that these ads target children, who can't tell the difference between a genuine message and clever marketing. Bright colours, catchy jingles and free toys make unhealthy food look irresistible, and this is fuelling the obesity epidemic we see today. Some of you might argue that a ban takes away our freedom of choice. I understand that point, but we already ban advertising for cigarettes and alcohol, so why should junk food be any different? Banning the ads wouldn't stop anyone buying a burger — it would simply stop companies pushing it down our throats. On top of that, healthy food producers can't compete with the millions that fast food chains pour into marketing. A ban would level the playing field and give people a fair chance to make better choices. What do you all think? Has anyone here actually changed their eating habits because of an advert? I'd love to hear your views! Dilnoza Karimova
t2.uzSample:
Zararli ovqatlar reklamasi hamma joyda bo'lib, bizning ovqatlanish odatlarimizga ta'sir qilmoqda. Men bunday reklamalarni taqiqlash yoki qattiq cheklash kerak, deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar reklamasi semizlik epidemiyasiga hissa qo'shadi. Bu reklamalar sog'lom bo'lmagan ovqatlarni jozibali va istakli ko'rsatadi, ayniqsa reklamani ma'lumotdan ajrata olmaydigan bolalar uchun. Reklama cheklovlari bo'lgan mamlakatlarda aholi salomatligida yaxshilanishlar kuzatildi.

Ikkinchidan, zararli ovqatlar kompaniyalari reklamaga milliardlab dollar sarflaydi, sog'lom oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqaruvchilari esa raqobatlasha olmaydi. Bu bizning oziq-ovqat muhitimizda qayta ishlangan ovqatlar hukmronlik qiladigan notekis vaziyatni yaratadi.

Biroq, qarshilar buni tanlash erkinligini cheklaydi va biznesga zarar yetkazadi, deb ta'kidlaydi. Shunga qaramay, biz allaqachon aholi salomatligi sabablari tufayli sigaret va alkogol reklamalarini cheklaymiz. Zararli ovqatlar ham shunga o'xshash sog'liq muammolarini keltirib chiqaradi.

Bundan tashqari, reklamani taqiqlash mahsulotlarni taqiqlamaydi - odamlar ularni sotib olishni tanlashi mumkin. Bu shunchaki psixologik zaifliklardan foydalanadigan manipulyativ marketingni olib tashlaydi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, zararli ovqatlar reklamasi taqiqlari shaxsiy tanlovni olib tashlamasdan, aholi salomatligini, ayniqsa bolalar salomatligini himoya qiladi.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar? Yomon.
Reklamalar? Yomon.
Reklama yo'q!
Menga tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar yoqmaydi.
t2.uzSampleA2:
Menimcha, zararli ovqat yaxshi emas.
Reklamalar televizorda va ular bolalar uchun yomon.
Bolalarga reklamalar yoqadi va ular zararli ovqat yeyishni xohlashadi.
Bu sog'lom emas.
Ehtimol, endi reklamalar bo'lmasligi kerak, chunki bu sog'liq uchun yomon.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, zararli ovqatlar reklamasi to'xtatilishi kerak.
Bu odamlar uchun, ayniqsa bolalar uchun yaxshi emas, chunki ular reklamalarni ko'rishadi va zararli narsalarni yeyishni xohlashadi.
Misol uchun, shirinliklar va chips reklamalari juda ko'p.
Bu ovqatlar sizning sog'lig'ingiz uchun yaxshi emas.
Shuningdek, bu kompaniyalar reklamaga juda ko'p pul sarflashadi, shuning uchun sog'lom ovqatlar raqobat qilishlari qiyin.
Biroq, ba'zi odamlar nima yeyish ularning tanlovi deyishadi.
Mening fikrimcha, odamlarni zararli reklamadan himoya qilish muhim.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar reklamalarining keng tarqalishi jiddiy xavotirlarni uyg'otadi. Menimcha, ularni taqiqlash yoki sezilarli darajada cheklash uchun jiddiy asos bor.
Bu reklamalar ko'pincha zaif guruhlarni, ayniqsa bolalarni nishonga oladi, sog'lom bo'lmagan mahsulotlarni targ'ib qilish uchun jozibali vizual va chalg'ituvchi da'volardan foydalanadi. Bu noto'g'ri ovqatlanish odatlariga, semizlik va unga bog'liq kasalliklar darajasining oshishiga olib keladi.
Bundan tashqari, tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar reklamalarining haddan tashqari ko'pligi sog'lomroq alternativalarni targ'ib qiluvchi xabarlarni yo'qqa chiqaradi. Bu sog'lom bo'lmagan tanlovlar normal va istalgan bo'lib ko'rinadigan muhitni yaratadi.
Albatta, ba'zilar reklama taqiqlanishi tanlash erkinligini buzadi, deb ta'kidlaydi. Biroq, xuddi tamaki va alkogol reklamalarini tartibga solganimiz kabi, biz jamoat salomatligiga aniq zarar yetkazadigan mahsulotlarni targ'ib qilishni ham tartibga solishimiz kerak. Taqiqlash tanlovni butunlay yo'q qilmaydi, lekin u o'yin qoidalarini tenglashtiradi va iste'molchilarga yanada asosli qarorlar qabul qilish imkoniyatini beradi. Oxir oqibat, jamoat salomatligiga keltiriladigan foyda potentsial kamchiliklardan ustun turadi.

t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is nervous about visiting the dentist. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the dental clinic. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear BrightSmile Team, Thank you for asking about my recent dental appointment. I was pleasantly surprised by my experience. The clinic was spotlessly clean and modern. Your receptionist was incredibly welcoming, which helped calm my nerves. The dentist explained every procedure clearly and was very gentle throughout. However, I have some suggestions. The waiting time was longer than expected despite having an appointment. I would suggest implementing a text notification system to alert patients when the dentist is ready. Additionally, I would appreciate if you offered teeth whitening packages and flexible payment plans for expensive treatments. Evening appointments would also be helpful for working patients. Overall, I am very satisfied and will return for my next check-up. Yours sincerely, Javohir Tojiyev
t12.sampleA1:
Hi BrightSmile!


I come to your clinic. It is good. The doctor is nice. I like the chair. Thank you. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello BrightSmile,


Thank you for the email. My visit was good. The clinic is clean and the people are nice. I liked the doctor. But the waiting was long. Maybe you can make it faster. And more chairs in the waiting room. Thank you!


Bye,


Javohir Tojiyev
t12.sampleB1:
Dear BrightSmile Team,


Thank you for your email. I'm writing to tell you about my visit to your clinic. I think the clinic is very nice and clean. The staff were also very friendly and helpful. The dentist explained everything very well, which I appreciated.


However, I think there are some things you could improve. For example, it was difficult to find parking. Also, I think you should offer more magazines to read while waiting. In my opinion, this would make the experience better.


Overall, I had a good experience. Thank you for your service.


Sincerely,
Javohir Tojiyev
t12.sampleB2: Dear BrightSmile Team, Thank you for your email asking about my recent visit to your clinic. Overall, I was very impressed with my experience. Your facilities were spotlessly clean and modern, and I felt at ease from the moment I walked in. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the dentist took the time to explain each step of the treatment, which really put my mind at rest. The booking system was straightforward and easy to use, so I have no complaints there. However, I would suggest a couple of improvements. It would be great if you could offer evening appointments for those of us who work full-time, as well as flexible payment plans for more expensive treatments. All in all, I was thoroughly satisfied and will happily recommend you to my friends and family. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli BrightSmile jamoasi,

Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan tish davolashim haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men tajribamdan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Klinika juda toza va zamonaviy edi. Qabulxonangizdagi xodim juda xushmuomala bo'lib, bu asablarimni tinchlantirishga yordam berdi. Tish shifokori har bir muolajani aniq tushuntirdi va davolanish davomida juda ehtiyotkor edi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Belgilangan vaqtimga qaramay, kutish vaqti kutilganidan uzoqroq bo'ldi. Shifokor tayyor bo'lganda bemorlarni ogohlantirish uchun SMS xabarnoma tizimini joriy etishni taklif qilaman.

Bundan tashqari, agar siz tishni oqartirish paketlarini va qimmat davolash usullari uchun moslashuvchan to'lov rejalarini taklif qilsangiz, minnatdor bo'lardim. Kechki qabullar ishlaydigan bemorlar uchun ham foydali bo'lar edi.

Umuman olganda, men juda mamnunman va keyingi tekshiruvim uchun albatta qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,

Javohir Tojiyev

Hurmatli BrightSmile jamoasi,


Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Sizga klinikangizga tashrifim haqida aytib bermoqchiman. O'ylashimcha, klinika juda yaxshi va toza. Xodimlar ham juda do'stona va yordam berishga tayyor edilar. Stomatolog hamma narsani juda yaxshi tushuntirdi, bu menga juda yoqdi.


Biroq, o'ylaymanki, siz yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi narsalar bor. Masalan, mashina qo'yish joyini topish qiyin edi. Shuningdek, kutish vaqtida o'qish uchun ko'proq jurnallar taklif qilishingiz kerak deb o'ylayman. Mening fikrimcha, bu tajribani yanada yaxshilaydi.


Umuman olganda, men yaxshi tajribaga ega bo'ldim. Xizmatlaringiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Tojiyev
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli BrightSmile jamoasi,


Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan uchrashuvim bo'yicha kuzatuv xatingiz uchun rahmat. Klinikangizdagi tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozmoqdaman.


Umuman olganda, sharoitlar meni hayratga soldi; klinika zamonaviy va yaxshi saqlangan ko'rinardi. Xodimlar xushmuomala va professional edilar, bu esa ijobiy muhit yaratdi. Stomatolog tekshiruvni puxta o'tkazdi va taklif qilingan davolash rejasini aniq tushuntirdi.


Biroq, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, onlayn bron qilish tizimi, ishlayotgan bo'lsa-da, yanada qulayroq bo'lishi mumkin. Men uni navigatsiya qilishda biroz chalkash deb topdim. Ikkinchidan, kechikishlar bo'lishi mumkinligini tushunsam ham, uchrashuvim taxminan 20 daqiqa kechikib boshlandi. Ehtimol, uchrashuv vaqtlarini aniqroq baholash foydali bo'lar edi.


Bundan tashqari, agar siz klinika ichida og'iz gigienasi mahsulotlarining kengroq assortimentini sotsangiz, foydali bo'lardi. Masalan, tishlararo cho'tkalar va ftorli og'iz chayish vositalarining tanlovi qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'lardi.


Xulosa qilib aytganda, men olgan xizmatimdan mamnun bo'ldim va kelajakdagi uchrashuvlar uchun qaytib kelishni o'ylab ko'raman. Ushbu takliflarga e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat.


Hurmat bilan,
Javohir Tojiyev
